description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Modal' which renders a modal dialog UI element. The component manages event listeners for the Escape key to close the modal, and renders various UI elements including headers, children, footer, and close button with specific styles and ARIA attributes for accessibility.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal dialog with customizable title, content, and footer. Handles Esc key to close the modal and provides accessibility features.
